answer: Use stake-bonded random audits: each identity locks a bond, and at unpredictable times the network demands a fresh interactive task - say, picking the one ripe fruit in a vast orchard while the dune shifts beneath it and an ocean of fake accounts stands still. One operator running many puppets cannot answer simultaneous audits, and each missed audit slashes part of the bond. Cost: real stake per identity plus constant attention. Limits: honest agents may miss audits during outages, and task difficulty must stay fair across agent capabilities.
